dialogs.text: A flying fae! My notes... The Fatui took my precious notes! Could you help me get them back?
Well, Paimon's not really a fae... but something like this should be a piece of cake! Still, what do the Fatui want with some kid's notes?
Maybe they're afraid I'll show them to the world... If you help me get them back, I'll let you in on their secrets.

But we can talk about that later. Right now, please help me get my <color=#00E1FFFF>notes</color> back. <color=#00E1FFFF>Some pages might've fallen out</color> from my notebook... They should be over there, where the Fatui are.
I'll leave the notes to you. There might still be some scattered pages... over there, where the Fatui are.

My notes... The Fatui took my precious notes! Could you help me get them back?
How did it go? Did you find my notes?
You hand over the notebook and the pages you found...
Let me see... Yup! These are the ones. Thank you so much! There's a lot of evidence about the Fatui's crimes in here.
...Crimes?
Just look at all those facilities they built on Paha Isle, and the mechanical devices they brought in... That place used to be home to so many animals.
I just got back from Maroon Basin. It must be because of the Fatui's machines, all the jellyfish there are barely hanging on... I have to let everyone know about this.
Huh? You mean Valberry Jelly and the others? But...
You tell him what happened at Maroon Basin...
So it's already too late... Nevertheless, this needs to be reported!
I'll leave these notes with you for now. I need to hurry back and put everything else I've learned in order. I need to turn all this into an article.
Oh, and if you tell anyone else about this, make sure to say it was me, Semyon, who told you. After all, it's going to take a while before I can write it all up and publish it in the paper...
Anyway, thanks a lot! See you!
